title: Rescue gone wrong
description: Kylo Ren's tie whisper approaches, closing in quickly. Rey ignites her lightsaber, and leaps over the tie, slicing off the wing and downing Ren. At that moment Rey, having discovered that Chewbacca had been taken captive, reaches out with the Force to stop the transport from departing. Ren, having escaped the crash, pulls the transport to him, causing Rey to emit a stream of Force lightning that destroys the transport, with Chewie apparently inside!
